title: CAM Runtime brand color identity (palette + usage rules)
description: Canonical brand color palette for CAM Runtime, for the site + arts (and consumed by the README, CAM-331). GREENS: Fir Green #10C66F (primary accent: subscribe button, links, nav, highlights); Forest Green #003333 (deep green: text over green, e.g. calendar days); Aero Green #CAFFE3 (light green: welcome-page background, light highlight); White #FFFFFF (base). NEUTRALS: #1F1F1F (ink: dark text/backgrounds, tiles, dark cards, banner); #6F6F6F (secondary text); #9C9C9C (secondary over dark); #EDECF0 (surface: light cards/surfaces); #E3E3E5 (line: borders/dividers). SUBAGENT COLORS (ONLY to mark agents in figures, do NOT enter site chrome): Blue Lotus #426DFF, Lemon #AFE220, Sun Yellow #FFDF24, Salmon #FF6666. Canonical home is the cam-dss design system; within cam-cli this feeds the README brand (CAM-331) and optionally the splash accent (Fir Green). Usage rules above are normative.

spec.scope: Codify the CAM Runtime brand color palette as the canonical reference for the site, arts, and README. Within cam-cli the concrete deliverable is: (1) define the palette as NAMED design tokens in src/design/tokens.ts (so surfaces reference token names, not raw hexes) and (2) record the palette + usage rules as durable brand documentation (CONTEXT.md brand terms). GREENS: Fir Green #10C66F (primary accent: subscribe button, links, nav, highlights); Forest Green #003333 (deep green: text over green); Aero Green #CAFFE3 (light green: welcome background, light highlight); White #FFFFFF (base). NEUTRALS: #1F1F1F (ink: dark text/backgrounds/tiles/cards/banner); #6F6F6F (secondary text); #9C9C9C (secondary over dark); #EDECF0 (surface: light cards); #E3E3E5 (line: borders/dividers). SUBAGENT COLORS -- FIGURE-ONLY, explicitly NOT site/TUI chrome tokens: Blue Lotus #426DFF, Lemon #AFE220, Sun Yellow #FFDF24, Salmon #FF6666. The canonical home is the cam-dss design system; this issue mirrors the palette into cam-cli so CAM-329's splash accent (Fir Green) and the CAM-331 README reference a single source. Coordinate ordering with CAM-329 at plan time (CAM-329 consumes the Fir Green token; if CAM-329 ships first it may inline #10C66F pending this token). Do NOT force-restyle the whole TUI; only establish the tokens + docs and wire the splash accent if it lands here.
acceptanceCriteria: The brand palette is codified as NAMED design tokens in src/design/tokens.ts: the four greens (Fir Green #10C66F, Forest Green #003333, Aero Green #CAFFE3, White #FFFFFF) and the five neutrals (#1F1F1F, #6F6F6F, #9C9C9C, #EDECF0, #E3E3E5), each with a semantic name and a usage note.
The four subagent-marking colors (Blue Lotus #426DFF, Lemon #AFE220, Sun Yellow #FFDF24, Salmon #FF6666) are documented as FIGURE-ONLY and explicitly excluded from the site/TUI chrome tokens.
The palette and its usage rules are recorded as durable brand documentation (CONTEXT.md brand terms / a brand reference).

No existing color usage is force-migrated beyond establishing the tokens; the only wiring is the CAM-329 splash accent to the Fir Green token (coordinated at plan time), with no other behavior change.
typecheck passes and check:all is green.
